targets.authors: Miyake F, Nagaya K, Masuda K and Nakamura T
targets.title: A signature of cosmic-ray increase in AD 774–775 from tree rings in Japan.
targets.evidence_quote: Firstly, we present new 14C measurements over the period from 771–779 CE, spanning the years of the 775 CE event. Our results show the same sharp rise shown by Miyake et al. (2012), even though the Δ14C values are on average higher than the ones reported from the original study.
targets.outcome_quote: Firstly, we present new 14C measurements over the period from 771–779 CE, spanning the years of the 775 CE event. Our results show the same sharp rise shown by Miyake et al. (2012), even though the Δ14C values are on average higher than the ones reported from the original study.
